# deps: tools: add gorename

Add `gorename` (`golang.org/x/tools/cmd/gorename`) to the Go toolset. **Motivation:** refactoring — renaming identifiers by qualified spec across a package tree; the note quotes the tool's spec syntax (`"encoding/json".Decoder.Decode`, `json.go::x`, …).
